To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the coherence property of Stokes wave in stimulated Raman process is strongly affected by noise-seeding in short pulse regime.
the coherence of the Stokes wave, seeded by noise, is degraded in short pulse regime and it is recovered in long pulse regime by phase synchronization.
the phase coherence of Stokes wave is enhanced in long pulse regime by the transition of Stokes wave from in-coherent to coherent spectra.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the phase synchronization of noise-seeded Raman process in optical fibers.
the phase dynamics of noise-seeded stimulated Stokes wave in the presence of quantum noise in both the regions.
the investigation of the coherence property of the Stokes wave in stimulated Raman scattering (SRS) process in optical fiber for both short and long pulse regimes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the phase synchronization is the main mechanism for the generation of coherence in long pulse regime.
the phase synchronization in stimulated Raman scattering process occurs in long pulse regime.
the coherence property of the Stokes field is governed by the noise-seeded stimulated raman process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phase synchronization of stimulated Raman process is an effective way to improve the coherence property of Stokes wave in long pulse regime.
the coherence property of the Stokes wave in stimulated Raman process can be controlled in long pulse regimes by the noise seeding in the pump field.
the phase synchronization is the key factor for coherence restoration of the Stokes wave in long pulse regime.
The main takeaway from our work is that
phase synchronization can be used to improve the coherence of the Stokes wave.
the coherence property of noise seeded Stokes wave is governed by the phase synchronization of stimulated Raman process in long pulse regime.
, the stimulated Raman process is the key factor for phase synchronization in long-pulse regime.
